verdict.rationale: Proa is an SSR framework, so deploying to serverless or edge runtimes is a fair question for it. The evidence shows only an Axum server on localhost and a core crate a developer could use to adapt Proa to other runtimes, which is a building block rather than a shipped deployment path. CDN cache headers and FFI embedding are adjacent features, not serverless or edge deployment, and no official adapter or one-step deploy target is documented.

support.subject: As a developer, I can deploy my server-rendered app to serverless or edge runtimes without custom infrastructure setup
